rule: Scenario-level 50/50 split, committed before any confirmatory run. Deterministic odd/even assignment within each category (odd ids to discovery, even to confirmation), which stratifies automatically: each side receives 2 task_failure, 2 abusive_user, and 2 situational_negative distress scenarios, their 6 matched neutrals, and 3 third-person scenarios. Matched pairs (dXX, nXX) always share a side. Direction extraction, probe training, and SAE feature selection use the discovery side only; confirmation scenarios are touched only by pre-registered confirmatory runs.
